messages:
Sam: ok team, quick handoff — I'm taking the night bridge from 22:00 UTC. primary = Sam, secondary = Linh. leaving notes below.

Linh: thanks — I still don't have the grafana write role for the incident dashboards. I can view but can't annotate.

Sam: noted. you should have the temp cross-account role ARN I shared last week, but sounds like the session hasn't been assumed. Sam: ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall-night-relay

Daria: re: grafana annotations — you only need the dashboard_editor team role. @Kai added you to grafana-team last month?

Kai: I added Linh to grafana-team but we didn't push the annotation policy. I'll run a quick policy push. give me 2m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Oncall-Bot: Incident watcher enabled for thread 4399012345. Auto-alerts will page primary for Sev2+/latency spikes.

PagerDuty-Bot: PagerDuty escalation profile: /services/infra-nightly -> primary (Sam) -> 10m -> secondary (Linh) -> 15m -> escalation (SRE lead).

Sam: Checklist I'm leaving:
- PagerDuty: confirm you can acknowledge and escalate (PagerDuty web + mobile).
- AWS: assume role above, run quick creds smoke test below.
- Grafana: open the "prod-inference" dashboard and confirm annotations allowed.
- Runbooks: link to runbooks in pinned message.

Linh: can you paste the smoke test?

Sam: sure:
```
# smoke test for AWS assume-role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall-night-relay --role-session-name oncall-smoke
# then try a read-only call
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-inference-logs/ --profile assumed
```
If that fails, open an internal access ticket (IAM-REQ) and ping Kai.

Kai: pushed annotation policy. Linh, try refreshing Grafana and do a quick annotation on prod-inference (top-right menu). I also added a temporary Grafana-SSO mapping for you with TTL 8h.

Linh: annotation works now, can add notes. trying the assume-role... getting MFA prompt; do we have JIT flow?

Sam: yes — we use JIT for cross-account. use the CLI with --serial-number and --token-code from your authenticator. If that blocks, fall back to the emergency temp role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall-jit-temp (valid 1h).

Daria: FYI, if both role paths fail, you can ask PagerDuty to escalate to the SRE lead. I've put the SRE lead contact in the runbook.

Sam: runbook links (pinned):
- https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-latency
- https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pd-esc-procedures
- https://redwood.internal/runbooks/assume-role-jit

Oncall-Bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m before shift end send automated passoff template.

Linh: confirmed: PD acknowledge works on my phone, grafana annotations ok, assume-role + MFA succeeded. I'm good to be secondary. :thumbsup:

Sam: sweet. a couple quick notes on customer impact assessment: if error rate >1.5% sustained for 10m or p95 latency >1200ms, mark customer-impact = "partial" and open Incident(Severity 2). Follow runbook for comms.

Kai: also ensure you run the cache-warmup script after any model fallback — quick command below:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELAY_TOKEN" https://svc.redwood.internal/cache/warmup -d '{"prefix":"/models/*"}'
```

Sam: last: if you need elevated access mid-shift, follow JIT flow and ping me + Daria in thread; we'll approve and note the justification.

Linh: got it. I'll monitor the alerts. thanks for the litmus passoff.

Sam: thanks all — handing over. :white_check_mark:
